resumo: A fluffy offcut, paper that crumples, a wooden spoon, a dry sponge. Nothing small enough to fit whole in a mouth. More entertaining than an expensive toy.

secoes.texto: You do not need to buy anything. Gather five objects with very different surfaces in a shoebox and offer them one at a time, with you nearby the whole time. The game is the difference between them, not the quantity.

itens: A piece of wool or a knitted scarf.
A clean, dry sponge, one of the soft ones.
Cellophane or tissue paper, for the noise.
A wooden spoon and a metal one, to compare temperature and weight.
A plastic tub with a lid, which also works for banging.

secoes.titulo: The safety rules, which here are not a detail
itens: Nothing that fits through a toilet roll tube: if it fits, it chokes.
Nothing with glued-on parts, magnets, batteries or long string.
Everything goes in the mouth, so everything has to be washable.
You stay there the whole time. This is not a game to leave her alone with.

secoes.texto: Photograph the box laid out, with the five objects, before you offer it. A few years from now, that silly photo will remind you exactly what was in your house that year.
